name: Transmat
ownershipStory: May founded Transmat in 1986 to release his own Rhythim Is Rhythim material, starting with "Nude Photo." The label went on to release early work by Carl Craig (as Psyche), Suburban Knight, and other second-wave Detroit and Chicago-adjacent producers.
hook: The label Derrick May built to release "Strings of Life," and kept going as a launching pad for the next generation.
blurb: Derrick May founded Transmat in 1986, following Juan Atkins' example with Metroplex and keeping the label in the artist's own hands. It released his own Rhythim Is Rhythim records and later helped launch other Detroit-area producers, especially Carl Craig's early records, which makes it one of the clearest lines from the first wave of Detroit techno to the second.
